caption: The drawing depicts a standing pole screen comprised of a turned, dark brown wooden pole anchored by a circular, tiered base. The pole rises vertically and supports a shield-shaped screen at its upper portion. The screen is light tan or golden-yellow with curved edges at the top and modest scroll decorations. At the center of the screen, there is an illustration in blue and green hues showing a bird perched amidst shrubbery or foliage. The drawing is executed on beige paper and includes a smaller, less detailed pencil outline of the pole screen to the lower right. Adjacent to the smaller outline, there is handwritten text giving specifications and details of the pole screen, such as materials, dimensions, and date.
title: Pole Screen
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
